findings.title: Shared OS support does not compile; VT C and ConPTY are cut off
Default GTK runtime is not compiled
Selected OpenGL renderer is Linux-only
Selected kqueue backend exports an unusable fallback
Kitty graphics are accepted but never rendered
Private VT table prevents installation of effect callbacks
Default build enables neither native Wayland nor X11 integration
Terminal constructor ignores the caller allocator
Application-wide Quit confirmation is a dead end
Non-confirming Quit does not destroy windows
Launch-time LANG is discarded from child environments
Background-image configuration is ignored
Custom shaders are compiled but not applied
Renderer scrollbar updates are discarded
Two recoverable PageList allocation failures panic or abort
VT differential gate uses stale binaries and unbuildable source
No coverage-guided or live differential fuzz target exists
Linux integration templates have no repository installer
Performance warning widget is blank
Renderer inspector overlays are dropped
